exposure: women with vaginal bleeding but without placental abruption
women with placental abruption without vaginal bleeding
women with placental abruption with vaginal bleeding
women without placental abruption or vaginal bleeding
cohort: 417 women in a tertiary-care center, including women with and without placental abruption, women with vaginal bleeding, and healthy pregnant controls
finding: Women with placental abruption had significantly higher CRP levels than controls, regardless of bleeding status, suggesting a chronic process underlying placental abruption.
